label: Enabled
help: Main switch for Kiro Crew metrics telemetry.

label: Retention (days)
help: Prune local JSONL metric shards older than this many days.

label: Warm Set Cap
help: Max number of remote instances kept warm at once.

label: Browser Live-View Port
help: Pin the browser live-view server (playwright-cli show) to this loopback port.

label: Dashboard URL
help: Public URL for the dashboard (used in Slack links).

label: Archive Retention (days)
help: Days to keep compacted/rotated session archives before auto-cleanup.

label: Extra Skill Paths
help: Additional directories to scan for skills.
